blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City first district Rep. Paolo Duterte on Friday filed libel and cyber libel complaints against National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag, dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., and GMA Network officials and reporters over the former cop’s “cash delivery” allegations against him. Duterte filed the complaints at around 11 a.m. Friday at the Davao City Prosecutor’s Office.
